title: Payroll: Preparation, Analysis and Management
overview: Employee compensation, including payroll and benefits, represents one of the largest expenses for any company, second only to the Cost of Goods Sold (COGS), rent, and depreciation. For manufacturing businesses, where these costs are part of COGS or operating costs, the impact is magnified. Proper management of payroll costs is crucial for effective analysis and decision-making. This course provides an introduction to the HR and accounting/finance departments, focusing on the payroll function. It covers the entire payroll process, from preparation and calculations to necessary controls and pre-checks to ensure data accuracy. The course emphasizes the importance of efficient workflow, confidentiality, and compliance with internal processes. Additionally, participants will learn how to analyze payroll and employee benefits using Excel. The course also addresses the relationship between accounting, auditing, and the payroll function, as well as how to prepare payroll budgets and manage related costs.
audience: This course is designed for payroll staff, payroll accountants, accounting assistants, payroll supervisors, HR professionals, and team members handling payroll. It is also suitable for employees interested in understanding and applying best practices in payroll management.
methodology: The course is based on presentations and practical examples from the instructor. Participants will engage in Excel exercises for payroll calculations and benefits management, as well as group workshops and presentations.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Understand how HR and accounting/finance departments contribute to organizational success.
Prepare and review monthly payroll for accuracy.
Calculate employee benefits, loans, vacations, and End of Service Benefits (EOSB).
Reconcile payroll with accounting and audit supporting documents for payments.
Develop monthly and annual payroll budgets.
Design and produce periodic payroll management reports and analysis.
